justification: Documentation only. Corrects two claims in the pitch package that were wrong in the buyer's favour - both UNDERSTATED the work - and records that the stylesheet its own regeneration command needs does not exist. No code, no query, no served output.

break_it.scenario: A buyer reads 'doc_claims.py runs on demand; not yet wired to a hook or CI' and asks why a check the seller sells is not switched on.
break_it.what_happens: The seller has undersold a check that has run on every push since #890 - the same PR the row cites. The claim reads as an admission and is simply false.
break_it.how: Corrected to what it does: runs on every push and in CI, in observation mode, so it reports and never blocks. Verified by following qa_gate.py::_load_doc_claims rather than grepping for the filename, which finds nothing because the call is a spec_from_file_location.

break_it.scenario: A buyer asks 'which of the 4,000 tests' and the real number is 5,460.
break_it.what_happens: A figure that has now been wrong twice - 3,207, then 4,024 - is quoted a third time. In a document whose whole subject is unverified claims, that is the worst possible thing to be caught on.
break_it.how: The document now carries the COMMAND rather than the number, with the 2026-08-17 reading given only as an example and labelled as one that will go stale.

break_it.scenario: Someone follows the README to regenerate the buyer-facing formats.
break_it.what_happens: pandoc is invoked with '-H style.html' and that file exists nowhere - not in docs/pitch/, not in the generated package. The command fails, or silently produces unstyled output.
break_it.how: Recorded inline with both remedies. Noted as the same failure the README already describes - a rendered artefact whose source was discarded - repeated one level up in the tooling.

post_merge.other_repo: The GENERATED package at 'solvyra/projects/compliance engine/pitch-package' still carries the old text in its html/docx/pdf. It is untracked by design and must be regenerated before anything is sent - which needs the missing stylesheet decided first.
post_merge.manual_verify: Read the three corrected passages. Then confirm the generated package has NOT been regenerated yet, so nothing goes out carrying the old 'not yet wired' line.
